ask: Rust 2021, std only, no crates. src/lru.rs: generic LRU<K: Eq + Hash + Clone, V> with capacity, get (freshness update), put, peek, remove, len, clear. Doubly-linked via a VecDeque of keys plus a HashMap. include #[cfg(test)] unit tests covering eviction order, overwrite, and zero-capacity. write the file.
prose:
`src/lru.rs` is written. To wire it into a crate, add `pub mod lru;` (or `mod lru;`) in `src/lib.rs` or `src/main.rs`, then run:

```
cargo test
```

All 16 tests cover eviction order (FIFO and access-promoted), overwrite promoting to MRU, zero-capacity no-op, `peek` not updating recency, `remove` freeing a slot, `len`/`clear`, capacity-one edge case, and non-`Copy` values. Let me know if you want anything added — benchmarks, a `get_or_insert` combinator, or a sized-value variant.
